[sys] 📺 Pattern Hunger. A sequence of foods. Eat them in the right order. The wrong order... disagrees with you.

The audience expects entertainment, not blood.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

The wrong order... disagrees with you. The audience knows the order. They are not telling.

[sys] 📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.

Vex is watching the dice. For the first time tonight, it is not smiling.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

[sys] 📺 The wheel slows. The pointer wobbles between fates.

You can see where it wants to land. You can't do anything about it.

📺 "Trust the feeling" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 Hardened The Guest. An alien ambassador is coming to dinner at your haven. Televised. Serve something it finds interesting, and survive an etiquette you were never taught. The rules have changed. The audience demanded it.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

📚 What you know: Bitter and fermented wins.

[sys] 📺 The meal is served. The ambassador lifts the bowl with two limbs at once — and extends a third toward you.

Nobody knows what the gesture means. The village is screaming advice at the screen. You have to pick.

📚 Mirror it exactly. Imitation reads as respect, not mockery — you learned that the hard way last time.

📺 "Shake it" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 The toast. The ambassador rises — which takes a while — and lifts its cup.

Whatever happens now, the whole village tells this story for years. The galaxy too.

📺 "Toast the village" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.
